messages:
anna: quick update — ran the end-to-end perf sweep comparing streaming (ws/sse) vs poll-based HTTP endpoints. GPUs: H100 (asia/preview), A100-80GB (us-west1), T4 (eu-west1). quant: fp16, tf32, int8 (GPTQ). kernels: cuBLAS, triton-fused, custom-attn-v2. charts attached in the thread.

cj: nice. what was the test harness + SLOs?

anna: used fortio + a small custom token-emitter to simulate 32/64/128-token requests. workloads: chat-like (~80 tokens avg) and short prompts (~20 tokens). target SLAs: p50 < 70ms, p95 < 200ms, p99 < 400ms for low-latency tier. throughput target: sustain 200rps per GPU for 80-token chat.

mike: summary numbers first pls

cj: paste from the run — small ascii table

```
config         | gpu   | mode   | quant | rps  | tok/s  | p50(ms) | p95(ms) | p99(ms)
---------------|-------|--------|-------|------|--------|---------|---------|--------
ws-streaming   | H100  | streaming | fp16  | 220  | 17600  | 34      | 120     | 340
http-poll      | H100  | polling   | fp16  | 160  | 12800  | 40      | 180     | 480
ws-streaming   | A100  | streaming | int8  | 350  | 28000  | 46      | 160     | 420
http-poll      | A100  | polling   | int8  | 290  | 23200  | 52      | 210     | 540
ws-streaming   | T4    | streaming | tf32  | 90   | 7200   | 85      | 320     | 760
http-poll      | T4    | polling   | tf32  | 70   | 5600   | 92      | 410     | 980
```

sarah: interesting — streaming consistently higher peak throughput but p99 can still be bad on small GPUs (T4). any idea on cause?

mike: looked into it — streaming benefits from continuous batching + kv-cache reuse, so average latency and tok/s improve. p99 regressions come from backpressure and head-of-line when a few large requests flood the batch window. observed a ~2x variance in kernel launch times when fused kernels hit large sequence-lengths.

cj: kernel notes: cuBLAS path had lower p50 on fp16 but fused triton kernels unlocked higher tok/s on int8 for A100. attention v2 reduced mem copies and helped p95 on H100.

anna: quality check: int8 (GPTQ) had a small regression on our eval set — ~0.8% drop on pass@1 for our safety/formatting prompts. we flagged it but still within acceptable threshold for batch-heavy workloads; for low-latency chat tier we should keep fp16 by default.

perf-bot: CI perf-run #21234 finished — artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/2109876543/ — includes raw traces, flamegraphs, and per-request logs

cj: load command used:

```
# fortio run
fortio load -qps 200 -t 120s -c 50 \
  -payload-file requests.json \
  http://<endpoint>/v1/stream
```

mike: also tested increasing the batching window (10ms -> 25ms) — throughput up ~12% on streaming but p95 increased ~30ms. tradeoff looks sane for batch-y workloads.

anna: region differences: us-west1 (A100) had best cost/tok. eu-west1 T4 struggled on p99. H100 (asia) gives best headroom for large models but we saw more variance in triton kernels on that infra — maybe driver/kernel mismatch on the image we used.

sarah: any immediate ops changes?

anna: proposer: defaults
- low-latency tier: websocket streaming, fp16, cuBLAS primary, H100 in us-west1 if available, prefer soft batching (10ms)
- throughput tier: websocket streaming, int8+triton-fused on A100, batching window 25ms, autoscale up earlier
- fallback: polling endpoints for small bursty traffic in constrained regions (T4) — polling yields slightly worse avg latency but smoother p99 under burst.

cj: +1 to that. also add a runtime flag to clamp max batch size for streaming to reduce p99 spikes for chat workloads.

mike: i'll open a small infra PR to pin triton version and reprovision the H100 image we used — saw kernel warnings in dmesg.

perf-bot: created task PERF-447: pin triton 2.14.1, reprovision h100-image

anna: follow-ups: mike to PR infra fix, cj to add eval-run for int8 on our standard prompt suite, sarah to update onboarding doc with default tier recommendations.

sarah: will do. I'll also add a short blurb in the console docs about "ws vs poll" tradeoffs for customers.

cj: one more note — for customers on strict p99 SLOs we'd recommend dedicated A100s with int8 + triton, but keep a canary in fp16 to detect quality drift.

anna: thanks all — saved charts and raw traces in the perf-bucket. ping me if you want the zoom-in plots for a specific model or seq-len. :thumbsup:
